# Wiki Emitter

The Wiki Emitter is responsible for generating Markdown files that conform to OKF standards from the Knowledge IR. It processes entities and relationships to create pages that are both user-friendly and machine-readable. The emitted outputs include complete documentation and change logs that capture the state and modifications over time.
